title: narrative.control
description: Left-pane control panel snapshot: routing config + running state

tier.description: Selected narrative tier, null if auto-detect

mode.description: Selected pipeline mode, null if using tier default

autoDetect.description: Whether auto genre/tier detection is enabled

userInput.description: Current text in the story input box (may be partial draft)

runningRunId.description: Run ID of the currently executing pipeline, null if idle

runningEntryKey.description: Output directory key of the running pipeline

activeEntryStatus.description: Persisted entry status; null = never run

activeCanResume.description: Whether a checkpoint exists for this entry (narrative:resume-pipeline will work)

state.description: What the UI shows. `paused` = interrupted WITH a checkpoint (a display state, not a persisted one); `interrupted` = no checkpoint, must start over

primary.description: What the single primary button does right now — mirror this instead of re-deriving it from activeEntryStatus

cancelEnabled.description: Whether cancel (= pause, keeps the checkpoint) is available
